The '''Qina system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hanchin]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Qina/Legends|Qina]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
As [[Jason Fry]] confirmed in the endnotes to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Qina was initially misidentified as '''Mina''' in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]] article.
